state.rationale: Read-only JSON data files under H:/prism/state/**/*.json — databases, ledgers, snapshots. Not tool surfaces.

mcpData.rationale: Engine state, registries, dispatcher metadata, cross-session registries under H:/prism/mcp-server/data/**/*.json. Backing store, not invokable tool.

jmDieArchive.rationale: JM Die customer archive directories (depth-2). Static reference shop corpus — not a tool surface.

frontendComponents.rationale: React TSX components under mcp-server/web/src — UI surface, not tool calls. Out of scope for tool-savings audit.

tests.rationale: Vitest/node-test files under mcp-server/src/__tests__ + H:/prism/tests. Verification corpus, not tool surfaces.

mitOcw.rationale: Canonical path H:/prism/knowledge/mit-ocw/ not present at audit time. MIT-OCW content lives elsewhere (see CLAUDE.md §KNOWLEDGE-CONVERSION-MS0 — courses ingested into tribal/wiki/engines).
mitOcw.note: Knowledge corpus already converted to other PSN legs; raw OCW dir does not exist.

scheduledTasks.rationale: All 21 PRISM scheduled tasks are PSN-aware — documented in CLAUDE.md (fleet-reaper, fleet-memory-monitor, NN-graph retrain, slot-worktree migration, system-viz-revwalk, RGS-planner, zulu-orchestrator, MCP-server watchdog, SFC variability, synergy-watch, system-awareness freshness, hook-janitor, handoff-prune, etc.). Each runs via Task Scheduler, emits telemetry to state/, and is operator-controllable via env knobs.

notes: All 6 NA universes are backing-store / corpus / UI surfaces — not invokable tool routes. Excluded from tool-savings denominator by design.
scheduledTasks is the only universe in this audit slice with operational coverage relevance; all 21 are already PSN-aware (no CANDIDATE).
MIT-OCW raw corpus absent at canonical path; content already absorbed into wiki/tribal/engines per KNOWLEDGE-CONVERSION-MS0.
